sourceText:
Quick Fix Microwave Brownie
By: Rianne
Published: Friday, December 3, 2010 - 3:30pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons melted butter
2 tablespoons milk or water
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
4 tablespoons sugar
2 tablespoons cocoa powder
2 tablespoons flour
2 tablespoons semisweet chocolate chips
of salt

Preparation

1 In a small microwaveable bowl, mix together the melted butter, milk and vanilla extract. Add the sugar, cocoa powder, flour, chocolate chips and salt. Mix till combined. Microwave on HIGH for 1 minute and 30 seconds.  Allow to cool for 1 to 2 minutes. Top with a scoop of ice cream and drizzle with chocolate syrup.

About


Okay, I have my moments when I'm really REALLY craving for a chocolate brownie topped with a big scoop of vanilla ice cream and I don't want to wait.  I don't want to preheat, measure, mix, pour, bake and then cool.  It's been a long crazy day, I'm dead tired and all I want is a warm gooey brownie and I want it NOW!  Well, thank goodness I have my emergency microwave brownie to the rescue.  I even have a premixed bag in my cupboard so all I have to do is add the wet ingredients and zap it in the microwave.  Aaaaaaahhhh....CHOCOLATE HEAVEN :-)
